site.hero_lede: Two terrain packs for Unreal Engine 5, Unity, Blender and Houdini: a glacier cirque and an 8 km × 8 km alpine landscape.
site.products_lede: Two alpine terrain packs with 8K heightmaps for Unreal Engine 5, Unity, Blender and Houdini. Each pack is bought on its store listing.

products.title: AMP 02: Alpine Glacier Cirque
products.card_blurb: Glacier and non-glacier versions, 8K heightmaps, 12 masks and 8K textures.
products.lede: A glacier cirque terrain in two versions, with 8K heightmaps for each engine, a full set of masks, and textures.

hero.alt: Sunset light on a snow-covered glacier cirque: a jagged central peak above a small lake, with pine forest in the foreground.

specs.label: Meshes
specs.value: 14 FBX and OBJ meshes, 7 LODs per version, from about 26 million down to 6,400 vertices

specs.label: Heightmaps
specs.value: EXR 32-bit (8192), R16 for Unreal Engine 5 (8129), RAW for Unity (8193)

specs.label: Works with
specs.value: Unreal Engine 5, Unity HDRP and URP, Blender, Houdini

products.title: AMP 01: Large Scale 8K Alpine Landscape
products.card_blurb: An 8 km × 8 km basin with snow and non-snow versions, 7 LODs and 12 masks.
products.lede: An 8 km × 8 km alpine basin with snow and bare-rock versions, a full LOD chain, and heightmaps ready for the engine you use.

hero.alt: Sunlit alpine basin with a brown valley floor and snow-streaked mountain ranges on both sides under a cloudy sky.

specs.label: Meshes
specs.value: 7 LODs per version, from about 4 million down to 961 vertices

specs.label: Masks
specs.value: 12 terrain masks and a 32-bit normal map

specs.label: Works with
specs.value: Unreal Engine 5, Unity HDRP and URP, Blender, Houdini
